featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt thank you to all the teachers, and a very special thanks to Principal Ma’am, Mrs. Shally Gandhi, for organizing such a wonderful Halloween event. The welcome bands, the creatively designed horror lane, and the beautiful selfie points were all so well arranged. The teachers made both parents and children feel warm, comfortable, and right at home.

One thing that truly stood out was how Principal Ma’am herself personally attended to everyone — something very rare to see these days. It really shows the school’s dedication and personal touch.

I especially loved doing the ramp walk with my son, along with our little horror act — it was such a fun and unforgettable moment for both of us. The smoke effects and the entire runway setup were absolutely perfect.

Events like this are rare in schools, and as parents, we feel genuinely happy, connected, and emotionally involved. It almost felt like reliving our own school days. Thank you to the entire Orchids Malad East School family for creating such magical memories.

Happy Halloween 👻🎃 2025

featured_reviews.name: Porus Vakshoor
featured_reviews.review_text:
​My son Aoshnar Vakshoor attends the marine lines branch. Despite having full parental rights and paid the full tuition fees myself, this school chose to support a letter from the mother and has blocked me from accessing any information about my son's progress or well-being. They made this decision without requesting any official court document or legal proof—just based on a written request.
​This is a massive breach of trust and shows a shocking lack of awareness about parental rights.
​To make matters worse, when I called the Head Office to resolve this serious issue, the person I spoke with actually hung up on me and then refused to answer my subsequent calls.
​It's heartbreaking to be arbitrarily shut out of my child's life by his school, and their customer service response was appalling. Avoid this school if you are a co-parent.

The teachers and the entire faculty is so warm & loving. I would highly recommend this playschool.

featured_reviews.review_text: Da Vinci Montessori is a school which has made my child a thinker , communicator, also an empathetic little human. Leadership team and the teachers at Da Vinci Montessori are highly approachable and happy to meet the parents to help them understand phases of child development and how to navigate around it . With regular updates from the school we are constantly aware regarding the activities and tools used by the child at school and the learning outcome of the same . I would like to thank the school for all the efforts undertaken to create an environment which ensures the holistic development of the children.

featured_reviews.review_text:

She goes to BIS now. DVM has given her a strong foundation in math, language and culture. A Montessori environment gives the child the opportunity to learn with concrete materials with a gradually increasing level of difficulty. DVM provides just that. Congratulations to Ashani for giving South Mumbai children an opportunity to carry on their learning in a very holistic manner...My son attended DVM 3 years later and  I have seen the same commitment from Ashani, Suchi and  the entire team.
- Deepali

Da Vinci Montessori has always been a free space for me to learn and play in a fun way. It has taught me a lot of things that I wouldn't learn at that age elsewhere. Da Vinci Montessori has always let me do things my way and I learnt something in everything. The staff and faculty have always been warm, welcoming and supporting. Da Vinci Montessori makes school our home.
- Udita
